$comment: The P1 gate's answer key (ROADMAP P1 gate, #17): what each hand-written path in fixtures/paths must read on each local demo-shop branch. `pnpm gate:p1` records every criterion on both sides 3 runs in a row and compares each lane with this file (scripts/gates/lib/p1.ts).

pr is pr/discount-almost-right, whose labels scripts/demo/lib/ground-truth.ts proves: C1 pass, C2 FAIL (the total stays $50.00 until a reload), C3 pass, C4 pass. base is main, which has no discount codes: every lane reaches /cart, takes its PRE readings and ends trigger_absent, because there is no 'Discount code' textbox to fill.

Readings are matched by label, phase and, for POST, the offset after Tt: a label's nth POST reading is the one at offsetsMs[n]. kind must match; value is exact; includes lists lines the value must contain; bbox says whether there is one. A lane must have exactly these readings, nothing missing and nothing extra.
Checked on 2026-10-30 against both branches served locally with `next start` (:3001 and :3000), with core's Reader on 3 runs in a row; all 3 runs read the same.
